parole.testo: Internationalism via Italian laguna or perhaps German Lagune. First attested in 1793.

parole.significato: The lowest trump in a pack of tarokk cards, numbered I.
parole.testo: From Italian bagatto, via German Pagat. Doublet of bagatell.

parole.significato: an express messenger, especially one using relay horses
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian staffetta (“courier; relay race; relay team”), also via German Stafette (“courier; relay race”). Chiefly introduced via military jargon. First attested in 1697.

parole.significato: to traffic (to trade meanly or mercenarily)
parole.testo: Internationalism (compare English traffic, French trafiquer (“to traffic”), Spanish traficar (“to traffic”)), probably directly from Italian trafficare (“to trade; to traffic”), possibly also via archaic German traffegieren. Doublet of trafik.
